text:
The 2021 tree-cover loss on this property is now corroborated, based on the latest run (run-2, 12 Nov 2026).

- **Size:** 81.3 ha of loss in 2021, or 2.23% of the 3,643.5 ha property.
- **Corroboration:** The rule requires that a later year of the series was observed and that the JRC 2020 reference agrees on at least 50% of the event area. Both conditions are met. Data through 2025 are available, and JRC maps 98% of the event area as forest in 2020.
- **Forest type:** According to the 2021 national map, 68.1 ha was planted pine (*Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), 13.2 ha was outside mapped forest, and none was native forest. This is consistent with plantation harvest, though the tools do not state the cause.
- **Not counted:** A further 37.3 ha of 2021 loss was in patches under 0.5 ha, below the event threshold.

The earlier run (run-1, May 2022) found the same figures. It had no later year of data, so the event could not yet be corroborated then.
